rubric.role_summary: Senior motion graphics design role creating animated content for social campaigns, video platforms, and corporate communications, including motion graphics, kinetic typography, and After Effects templates.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior motion graphics design role creating animated content for social campaigns, video platforms, and corporate communications, including motion graphics, kinetic typography, and After Effects templates.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- BA/BS degree in Design or CS, or relevant experience.
- 6+ years of hands-on social content design.
- Advanced After Effects and Illustrator skills.
- Strong command of animation fundamentals, including timing, pacing, easing, and anticipation.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Social content design experience in an agency, brand, or newsroom environment.
- Experience collaborating on cross-team projects.
- Adobe Creative Suite skills for developing static designs and templates.
- Familiarity with B2B and digital marketing creative best practices.
- Advanced After Effects and Illustrator skills, with familiarity with Premiere, Photoshop, and Cinema 4D.
- Experience leveraging Google generative AI models; the named models are examples, not individually required.
- In-depth understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, and YouTube and effective content for each.
- Grasp of design fundamentals and current trends.
- Working knowledge of Google App Suite.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
